timestamp_parsing: decimal seconds to integer nanoseconds, round-half-to-even once

synchronization.evidence: Reference timestamps overlap LiDAR and IMU Unix-epoch ROS headers; replay time synchronization disabled. Exact dense-reference sub-frame clock uncertainty is unpublished.

reference_pose.axis_datum: right-handed metric map frame; absolute datum not required for relative motion
reference_pose.provenance: Publisher 2022 evaluator treats *_imu.txt as TUM IMU-body poses; raw bag gyroscope comparison across 503 turning intervals supports same IMU axes and world-from-IMU direction. See HILTI_EXP18_FRAME_AUDIT.md.

comparison_body.provenance: Pinned FAST-LIO source identifies body as IMU state; publisher *_imu.txt convention and raw-gyro frame audit support the identity body relation. No transform was fitted to FAST-LIO error.

reference_method: VILENS LiDAR-IMU trajectory registered to a surveyed prior map
claimed_instrument_specification: Publisher describes surveyed map registration at approximately 1–2 cm; this is not demonstrated Exp18 trajectory accuracy.
limitations: Dense reference and FAST-LIO share LiDAR/IMU sensing; error is qualified development evidence, not independent final truth.
Exp18-specific reference production conversion and exact sub-frame timing uncertainty are unpublished.
The candidate 32–36 s scene transition is not yet frozen as a weak-to-rich recovery event.
coverage_policy: source-order partition on backward timestamp or interval greater than 0.20 s, then sort/deduplicate only within each segment; exact endpoints valid

static_transforms_used: identity FAST-LIO IMU-state body to reference IMU body for development evaluation

quality_fix_flags: No per-pose quality or fix flags released in this dense reference file.
